title: Man Runs Out of Gas While Fleeing from Deputies on Stolen Motorcycle
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Peoria, Illinois — On August 6, 2025, Peoria County Deputies spotted a motorcycle with no registration and tried to stop it on Harmon Highway, but the driver fled.  Unfortunately for him, the stolen motorcycle ran out of gas while attempting to flee from the deputy. The suspect, Donald Shaw, was arrested for felony warrants, fleeing and eluding, possession of drug paraphernalia, and possession of a stolen motor vehicle.
